text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a fun day out, I ask Mejiro Palmer
if there's
anywhere else she'd like to go
before we head
back.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: How about we switch things up today and go somewhere you wanna go, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You're always busy, so I think a little
break would
do you some good!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's how we end up strolling around
town, but
we don't get far before...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Gasp! They opened up a new golf shop here! Wooow, that driver looks like it can really let 'em fly!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Nah, it's fine. I can check it out another
time.
We're in the middle of a walk right
now, after all!
choice_data_list: Want to take a quick peek?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Usually, she'd jump on the offer and fly
right into the shop, but something feels
off about her
today. Her weird behavior
continues too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Which movie do I wanna watch?
Honestly, the
whole line-up looks super
interesting, so
whichever one you pick!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Let's see... Oh, that'll be Brain-Bending Art Labyrinths ! Always nice to try something new!
choice_data_list: Then how about this 'Pick of the M...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: W-whoaaa... U-ummm...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They weren't kidding about the
"brain-bending" part. Most of the movie
went over my head. It was
probably
meant for art buffs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whew! What a flick! It was just so... So
fancy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
For sure! The visuals sure packed a
punch! Stuff always leaves so much
bigger an impact when it's
blown up on
the silver screen!
choice_data_list: True, it certainly was stylish.
True, it certainly was stylish, wa...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Is something bothering me? Hm... Now
that you
mention it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I've been getting a lot of sliced shots
during golf
lately, but that's about it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
How about you? Anything weighing you
down
recently? I'd be happy to lend you
an ear,
whatever it is!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Every time I try to ask her what's wrong,
she dodges the question and turns it
back to me.
Eventually, we wrap up our
day out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Welp! Here we are at my dorm. Today
flew by,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the fun day! Did you enjoy it
too?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Looks like something's troubling
you big
time. Well, come on, then! I'm
here to listen!
choice_data_list: It was fun, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm all ears to whatever you might be
worrying
about!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: ...Did you have fun, Palmer?
...Did you have fun, Palmer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I did! Nothing makes me
happier than
seeing you enjoying
yourself!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Um... I don't get what you're trying to
say.
choice_data_list: It's the exact same for me.
It's the exact same for me too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yep, sure did! Or I guess, I feel more
relieved
than anything 'cause I didn't
cause you any
trouble!
choice_data_list: Did you really have fun?
Did you really enjoy yourself?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No, but like, I do! And I did! Remember
the other
day?
choice_data_list: A bother?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You were planning to take care of some
work, but
you dropped everything just
to help me sell all
that milk.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That wasn't the only time, either. You're
always
putting my wants and needs
ahead of yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm happy and grateful that you've
always got my
back, for real! But like...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I don't want you to keep prioritizing me
if it
means neglecting your own wants
and needs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So... yeah! That's why I decided to be
more
careful about that from now on!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I guess you already saw right through
me, though,
huh?
choice_data_list: Palmer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I was really trying to act natural and
stuff, but
your sixth sense is, like, no
joke!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: You don't need to worry about me.
You don't need to walk on eggshell...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Supporting you is what I live for,...
Supporting you is my reason for li...
A relationship that suits us is ju...
A relationship that's true to us i...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: Supporting you is what I live for,...
Supporting you is my reason for li...
A relationship that suits us is ju...
A relationship that's true to us i...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Yeah, I gotcha. I mean, even
when...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hold the phone. What did you say
just now?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that! Do you realize what you just
said?
choice_data_list: "Because supporting you is my purp...
'Because supporting you is what ke...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Man, you're so oblivious
sometimes! Not
that that's a bad thing.
choice_data_list: Huh? What kind of trouble?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I'm gonna head back now! See
you
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I watch Mejiro Palmer jog back to her
dorm, I
can only hope she understood
what I was trying
to say.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Yeah, we were both acting mad
sus today,
weren't we?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'm there with you!
choice_data_list: I think a natural relationship is ...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No more walking on eggshells! You be
you and I'll
be me. Now lemme hear you
say, "Waheeey!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Finally, the Mejiro Palmer I know is
back. What a
relief.
